tool_args.rationale: The five paid observations are all at H≤0.48, while the target horizon is 20.4. Short-horizon data leave the slow adaptation timescale poorly identified, so acquire the specified slow-horizon discriminating probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon rows do not identify the slow adaptation timescale needed to forecast at H=20.4.
A long-horizon discriminating probe directly resolves the key slow-timescale ambiguity at lower cost.
It is irrelevant to the identified horizon ambiguity and has avoidable cost.
The available signatures and recalled mechanism note support sink-coupled adaptation; no oscillatory evidence warrants this alternative.
